SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE.
REPORT

SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE
File No. REGISTRY.
4447
SECTION 2
712-133
Date February 7, 1933

Subject (in full) Arrival of alleged undesirables from Japan.

Made by D.S.Prokofiev Forwarded by [Signature]

With reference to attached report dated January 31,1933
containing information received from the local Japanese Consulate-
General on the subject of certain foreigners who were refused per-
mission to land in Japan and subsequently left for Shanghai, enquiries
at the Passport Examination Office show that the correct names
of the persons mentioned in the attached report are as follows:-
1. Miss R.A.Rogalsky
2. Mr. J.E. Boulatoff
3. Mr. P.A.Artemieff .

Miss Rogalsky and Mr Boulatoff, Russian emigrants, arrived
in Shanghai from Kobe on January 16 and 10 respectively. They were
in possession of passports issued by the local Chinese authorities
and consequently had no difficulty in disembarking.

Mr. Artemieff, British by naturalization, together with
his wife and three children arrived here from Kobe on January 20
by the s.s. "Chichibu Maru". As he had no Chinese vise he was
requested to find persons in Shanghai who would furnish a written
guarantee as to his character etc., and pay the usual fees, pending
which his passport is being detained at the Passport Examination
Office.

Mr. Artemieff gave his address as c/o D. Essoyan, No 144
Baikal Road.

G. Prokofiev
D. S.

Officer i/c Special Branch.

上海公共租界工部局警务处。
报告

上海公共租界工部局警务处
档案号：登记处。
4447
第2科
712-133
日期：1933年2月7日

事由（全称）：据称不受欢迎人员从日本抵达。

制作人：D.S. Prokofiev 转呈人：[签名]

关于所附1933年1月31日的报告，其中包含从日本驻沪总领事馆收到的有关某些被拒绝在日本登陆并随后前往上海的外国人的信息，经向护照查验处查询，所附报告中提及人员的正确姓名如下：-
1. R.A. Rogalsky 小姐
2. J.E. Boulatoff 先生
3. P.A. Artemieff 先生。

Rogalsky 小姐和 Boulatoff 先生系俄国移民，分别于1月16日和10日从神户抵达上海。他们持有中国地方当局签发的护照，因此入境并无困难。

Artemieff 先生已归化入籍英国，偕同其妻子及三名子女，于1月20日乘“秩父丸”轮（s.s. "Chichibu Maru"）从神户抵达此处。由于他没有中国签证，被要求在上海寻找能就其品行等提供书面担保的人，并缴纳常规费用，在此期间，其护照由护照查验处扣留。

Artemieff 先生提供的地址为：贝加尔路144号 D. Essoyan 转交。

G. Prokofiev
D. S.

特别科科长。

SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE.
S. B. REGISTER
File No 4447
Special Branch, S. 12 Section, 37
REPORT
Date January 31, 1933.

Subject (in full) Movements of foreigners in Japan.

Made by D. S. Umemoto. Forwarded by [Signature]

The following information concerning the movements of
foreigners in Japan has been received from the local Japanese
Consulate:-

Rebecca Abramovna Regaliskaya, aged 35, clerk employed by
the International Savings Society at Honolulu, arrived in Kobe
from New York via Honolulu, en route to Shanghai, on January 12,
1933, by the s.s. "President Garfield" but she was prohibited
to land in Japan because she had no Japanese vise. She left for
Shanghai by the same steamer on January 13, 1933.

Yakoff Ehimovich Bratoff, aged 50, Russian labourer, ~~No. 1,100~~ and
San Francisco, U.S.A., arrived in Kobe from San Francisco en
route to Shanghai on the "Taiyo Maru" on January 6, 1933, but
was prohibited to land in Japan because he had no Japanese vise.
He left for Shanghai on the same steamer on January 8, 1933.
When interrogated he stated that he was proceeding to Shanghai
in order to live with his son-in-law Badonwasa (?), Italian,
who is an employee of the Shanghai Maritime Customs and residing
at No. 125/31 Route de Grouchy.

Peter A. Albenoff, British subject, carpenter, accompanied
by his wife and three children arrived in Kobe on January 13, 1933,
by the "President Madison" from New Zealand via Hongkong and
Shanghai with the object of proceeding to Vladivostok. Owing
to the fact that the Soviet Authorities refused to grant them
permission to enter Russia, Albenoff approached the British Consul
for assistance. As he had only yen 30.00 in his possession the
Consul and the British Society in Japan defrayed his travelling
expenses to Shanghai and he left Kobe with his family by the
"Chichibu Maru" on January 18, 1933.

[Signature]

特别科登记簿
档案号 4447
特别科，S. 12 分部，37
报告
日期：1933年1月31日。

事由（全称）：外国人在日本的动向。

制作人：D. S. Umemoto。转呈人：[签名]

以下关于外国人在日本动向的信息系从日本驻沪领事馆收到：-

Rebecca Abramovna Regaliskaya，35岁，受雇于檀香山国际储蓄会（International Savings Society）的职员，于1933年1月12日乘“加菲尔德总统号”轮（s.s. "President Garfield"）经檀香山从纽约抵达神户，拟前往上海，但因无日本签证被禁止在日本登陆。她于1933年1月13日乘同一艘轮船前往上海。

Yakoff Ehimovich Bratoff，50岁，俄国劳工，~~编号 1,100~~ 以及美国旧金山，于1933年1月6日乘“太阳丸”轮（"Taiyo Maru"）从旧金山抵达神户，拟前往上海，但因无日本签证被禁止在日本登陆。他于1933年1月8日乘同一艘轮船前往上海。在接受讯问时，他声称前往上海是为了与其女婿 Badonwasa (?) 同住，该女婿为意大利人，系上海海关职员，居住在古鲁西路（Route de Grouchy）125/31号。

Peter A. Albenoff，英国臣民，木匠，在其妻子和三个孩子的陪同下，于1933年1月13日乘“麦迪逊总统号”轮（"President Madison"）经香港和上海从新西兰抵达神户，目的是前往符拉迪沃斯托克（海参崴）。由于苏联当局拒绝给予他们进入俄罗斯的许可，Albenoff 向英国领事寻求协助。由于他仅有30日元，日本英国领事馆和大英协会（British Society in Japan）支付了他前往上海的旅费，他于1933年1月18日携家人乘“秩父丸”轮离开神户。

[签名]

pages.en:
Labour (2)

Woosung Hankow Chinese Pilots Association -
attempts to force foreign shipping firms
to engage pilots through this organization

The above mentioned organization was inaugurated
on January 1, 1933 with offices at 30 Nanking Road.
It has obtained recognition from the Nanking Government
and consequently its members have been granted licences
by the authorities to pilot vessels in the Yangtze.

The new body later absorbed the Yangtze Chinese
Pilots Association, 516 Broadway East which had never
gained the recognition of the Government organs.

On January 16, the first mentioned body approached
Messrs Muller & Co., 14 The Bund and requested this
Company to employ pilots in future through the
Association. Messrs Muller decided to consider this
request but as the pilot who had been engaged to take
a vessel of the Company to Wuhu that day refused to
undertake the commission, the Shipping concern engaged
a pilot from the Yangtze Chinese Pilot Association.
Efforts were made by the Woosung Hankow Association to
intimidate this man and on his return from up river on
January 26 he was attacked by a crowd of Chinese at
Woosung and finally taken to the Association at 30
Nanking Road where he was fined $1,000 for breaking the
**〔此处转录不清〕**

**〔此处转录不清〕** the commission for the pilotage.

劳工 (2)

吴淞汉口中国引水员公会 -
试图强迫外国航运公司
通过该组织雇佣引水员

上述组织于1933年1月1日成立，办公地点位于南京路30号。
它已获得南京政府的认可，因此其成员已获当局颁发在长江驾驶船舶的执照。

该新机构后来吸收了位于百老汇路（东）516号的长江中国引水员公会，后者从未获得政府机构的认可。

1月16日，前述机构接触了位于外滩14号的穆勒洋行（Messrs Muller & Co.），并要求该公司今后通过该公会雇佣引水员。穆勒洋行决定考虑这一请求，但由于当天受雇将该公司一艘船只驶往芜湖的引水员拒绝承担此项任务，该航运公司从长江中国引水员公会雇佣了一名引水员。吴淞汉口公会试图恐吓此人，1月26日当他从上游返回时，在吴淞遭到一群中国人的袭击，最后被带至南京路30号的公会，除罚款260美元作为引水佣金外，还因违反**〔此处转录不清〕**条件而被罚款1,000美元
**〔此处转录不清〕**。
